page_summary: This section discusses the importance of management-level responsibility for cybersecurity in ports. It emphasizes the need for clear ownership and oversight, highlighting that designated leadership can enhance organizational resilience. The text outlines the roles of senior executives in managing cybersecurity risks and the establishment of port-wide governance structures, such as cybersecurity steering committees, to coordinate responsibilities and policies across different organizations within the port ecosystem.

regions.label: Box 5
regions.description: Discussion on the establishment of cybersecurity steering committees in ports to align priorities and responsibilities.
